title: Echo-Slot CAM Bridges — Deep Wiring
brief: Five BRIDGE-DEEP wiring units that connect already-built PRISM engines across CAD/CAM/operator/post boundaries: CAD AI→CAM AI strategy seed, operator-in-the-loop gates at every autonomous boundary, and SFC speeds/feeds→Fusion 360/hyperMILL/Inventor HSM cycle-param bridges. Each bridge is a pure function in CamBridgeKitEngine; per echo's slot-soul refuse-list, NEVER inlines feed/speed values and NEVER drops CAM-system context on translate (datums, tool numbers, WCS).

close_out_log.note: cad_cam_handoff bridge — CAD AI geometry → CAM strategy seed with feature→strategy_id mapping, datum preservation, unhandled-cycle-hint R12 surfacing
operator_gates_emit bridge — 5 stage defaults (cad_geometry/cam_strategy/cam_toolpath/post_processor/gcode_release) with per-stage role + blocking convention
sfc_fusion_bridge — SFC output → Fusion 360 'Adaptive Clearing' with stepover_pct derived from ae/tool_dia
sfc_hypermill_bridge — SFC output → hyperMILL 'OptiRough' with 30% plunge-factor convention
sfc_inventorhsm_bridge — SFC output → Inventor HSM 'Adaptive 2D' with optimal_load_mm = ae_mm engagement control

units.title: U-BRIDGE-CAD-CAM-HANDOFF — CAD AI → CAM AI autonomous handoff
exit_conditions: cadCamHandoff() maps CAD geometry → CamStrategySeed with per-feature strategy_id
Preserves datums per echo refuse-list (drop = R12)
Unhandled cycle hints surface in unresolved list (fail-loud)
Dispatcher action cam_bridge_cad_cam_handoff invokable
units.description: Bridges CAD-generation AI output into the CAM-programming AI strategy planner. Maps cad cycle_hint strings to known CAM strategy_ids; falls back to rough_adaptive for unknown hints with explicit unresolved surfacing.

units.title: U-BRIDGE-OPERATOR-GATES — operator-in-the-loop approval gates
exit_conditions: operatorGatesEmit() produces typed OperatorGateRequest per stage
5 stage defaults (cad/cam_strategy/cam_toolpath/post/gcode_release) with correct role + blocking
Operator can override required_role at the call site
Dispatcher action cam_bridge_operator_gates_emit invokable
units.description: Unconditional operator review gates wired at every autonomous-output boundary. G-code release defaults to blocking machinist signoff per shop_floor tier.

units.title: U-BRIDGE-SFC-FUSION — SFC speeds/feeds → Fusion 360 bridge
exit_conditions: sfcFusionBridge() emits FusionCycleParams with rpm + feed_mm_min verbatim
stepover_pct = (ae_mm / tool_diameter_mm) × 100 capped at 100
Default cycle_strategy = 'Adaptive Clearing'; override supported
Dispatcher action cam_bridge_sfc_fusion invokable
units.description: Bridges SpeedFeedOrchestrator output directly into Fusion 360 adaptive-clearing cycle parameters. Stepover converts from absolute mm to percentage per Fusion's convention.

units.title: U-BRIDGE-SFC-HYPERMILL — SFC speeds/feeds → hyperMILL bridge
exit_conditions: sfcHyperMillBridge() emits HyperMillCycleParams with absolute mm stepover/stepdown
plunge_feedrate defaults to 30% of milling_feedrate (hyperMILL OptiRough convention)
Override plunge_factor supported
Dispatcher action cam_bridge_sfc_hypermill invokable
units.description: SFC output drives hyperMILL OptiRough cycle parameters. Plunge feed defaults to 30% of milling feed per hyperMILL convention.

units.title: U-BRIDGE-SFC-INVENTORHSM — SFC speeds/feeds → Inventor HSM bridge
exit_conditions: sfcInventorHsmBridge() emits InventorHsmCycleParams with optimal_load_mm + max_step_down_mm
optimal_load_mm == ae_mm (HSM engagement control)
Default cycle_strategy = 'Adaptive 2D'; override supported
Dispatcher action cam_bridge_sfc_inventorhsm invokable
units.description: SFC output drives Inventor HSM Adaptive 2D cycle parameters. Optimal Load (engagement control) maps directly from SFC's radial depth.

acceptance: 5 bridge functions in CamBridgeKitEngine + 5 dispatcher actions on prism_cam + 35+ tests passing covering happy paths, schema invariants, R12 surfacings, and per-CAM-system convention quirks.

risks.description: CAM-system cycle conventions evolve (Fusion 'Adaptive Clearing' vs 'Pocket Clearing' renaming, hyperMILL OptiRough plunge-factor convention) — bridges are surface-level; defer per-version-specific quirks to per-system specialized engines.

operator_gates_emit returns a REQUEST object — the actual gate enforcement (block-until-approved) is the caller's responsibility. This MS produces the typed gate primitive; the gate-handler service is a follow-up.
